Fabled.name: Doomsayer
Fabled.description: If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.

Fabled.name: Angel
Fabled.description: Something bad might happen to whoever is most responsible for the death of a new player.

Fabled.name: Buddhist
Fabled.description: For the first 2 minutes of each day, veteran players may not talk.

Fabled.name: Hell's Librarian
Fabled.description: Something bad might happen to whoever talks when the Storyteller is talking, or talks too much.

Fabled.name: Revolutionary
Fabled.description: 2 neighboring players are known to be the same alignment. Once per game, one of them is drunk until dusk.

Fabled.name: Fiddler
Fabled.description: Once per game, the Demon secretly chooses an opposing player: all players vote on which of those 2 players dies. The chosen player's team loses.

Fabled.name: Toymaker
Fabled.description: The Demon may choose not to wake. If they don't, a good player dies. There is 1 extra bluff.

Fabled.name: Fibbin
Fabled.description: Once per game, 1 good player might get false information.

Fabled.name: Duchess
Fabled.description: Each day, 3 players may visit you. At night*, each visitor learns how many visitors are evil, but 1 gets false info.
Fabled.otherNightReminder: Wake each visitor. Tell each how many visitors are evil, but give one of them false information.

Fabled.name: Sentinel
Fabled.description: There might be 1 extra or 1 fewer Outsider in play.

Fabled.name: Spirit of Ivory
Fabled.description: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.
